Projects

  • RLVR Pipeline

    The project studies whether larger language models demonstrate superior learning capabilities in mathematical reasoning when trained with RLHF. It replicates the training pipeline proposed in the DeepSeek-R1 paper with different model sizes from the Qwen/2.5 family. The study includes a technical report with the results.

  • Kubernetes AI Cluster

    Terraform infrastructure for deploying an Amazon EKS cluster optimized for AI/ML workloads with Karpenter for node autoscaling, NVIDIA GPU Operator for GPU support, and KubeRay for distributed computing.
